headline: Sensex Rallies 1,000 Points as FM Sitharaman Hints at LTCG and STT Tax Review

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: FM Sitharaman signaled openness to reviewing LTCG and STT taxation, significantly boosting investor sentiment
RBI's commitment to preventing excessive rupee volatility provided stability to the currency markets
Markets staged a strong recovery after the previous session's losses triggered by oil price spikes and foreign outflows
Positive global cues and strong buying interest in IT, metal, and realty sectors supported the intraday rally
whatHappening: The Sensex surged over 1,000 points while the Nifty 50 reclaimed levels above 22,700 following the FM's remarks
AI-linked stocks including Hitachi Energy and E2E Networks fell up to 5% following a global rout in the sector
Sun Pharma's board approved a plan to raise up to ₹10,000 crore through non-convertible debentures
NPCI announced that MDR charges on UPI payments will be implemented after the Diwali festival
summary: Indian markets rallied sharply on October 13, with the Sensex gaining over 1,000 points following FM Sitharaman's comments on a potential LTCG tax review. While the broader market recovered from previous losses, AI-linked stocks faced a sell-off due to global trends. Sun Pharma also announced a significant ₹10,000 crore fund-raising plan.
